name: an-export-folder-belongs-to-one-show
find:
case .neverExported, .lostTrack:
            return nil
        case .finished, .unfinished, .unreadable:
            return event.exportPath
replace:
case .neverExported:
            return nil
        case .lostTrack, .finished, .unfinished, .unreadable:
            return event.exportPath
breaks: the export screen offers a one-click button pointing at a folder nothing is at, so pressing it creates a new empty folder where Dan moved one away from. That is the ordinary case rather than the exotic one: measured on the live store 2026-09-02, 9 of 21 events record an export path and 0 of those 9 folders are still at it (#1048, #1110)
